1.title: Cut off one end plug
1.say: Cut off the clear plug on either end with cutters, so that end is left flat.
placements: clear plug on end of network cable → cut off just below plug leaving flat cut bare end, in the video blue cable on dark table either end works
cutters → closed across cable just below clear plug
watch_for: if the end is jagged or slanted the cutters did not close square, recut a little higher
if both ends still have plugs you cut nothing, check one end is flat and bare
1.check_yourself: It should look like the cable lies coiled with one clear plug attached and one flat cut bare end.
1.safety: Keep your fingers clear of the blades, so you do not get cut.

2.title: Take cover off wire tip
2.say: Strip about an inch of outer cover off the cut end with strippers, so eight small wires show.
placements: outer cover of network cable → stripped back about one inch from flat cut end exposing eight small wires, in the video light blue cover on dark table
wire strippers with yellow handles → closed gently around outer cover about one inch from tip
watch_for: if small wires are nicked or cut the strippers closed too hard, strip a fresh bit higher
if you see only plastic and no wires you did not strip enough, strip a little more
2.check_yourself: It should look like eight small colored wires stick out of the outer cover at the cut end.
2.safety: Keep fingers away from the stripper blades, so you do not get pinched or cut.

3.title: Untwist and straighten all wires
3.say: Untwist all the small twisted wires with your fingers, so each wire sits separate. Straighten each wire flat with your fingers, so all eight fan out straight.
placements: eight inner twisted wires → separated and straightened to fan straight out from edge of outer cover, in the video fanned on dark table
white string inside cable → pulled out and cut off if present
watch_for: if wires still curl around each other they are still twisted, keep pulling apart until straight
if a wire kinks back the smoothing was uneven, smooth it again with fingers
3.check_yourself: It should look like eight straight inner wires fan out from the outer cover with no twists.

4.title: Put small cover on cable
4.say: Slide the small cover onto the cut end and down the cable, so it waits below the bare wires.
placements: small protective cover for plug → slid over cut wire tips and pushed down the network cable below bare wires with wide opening facing tips, in the video small blue boot on light blue cable
watch_for: if the cover will not go on it is backwards, flip it and try the other opening
if the cover sits up among the bare wires it will block the plug, push it far down the cable
4.check_yourself: It should look like a small cover sits around the cable below the exposed wires.

5.title: Line wires up green first
5.say: Lay four wires left to right as green striped then green then orange striped then blue, so they start right. Lay the last four wires as blue striped then orange then brown striped then brown, so the row is complete. Trim the tips even with cutters, so they slide in together.
placements: white with green stripe wire → position 1 on far left with plug clip facing away, in the video leftmost of eight on dark table
solid green wire → position 2 next to white with green stripe with clip facing away
white with orange stripe wire → position 3 next with clip facing away
solid blue wire → position 4 next with clip facing away
white with blue stripe wire → position 5 next with clip facing away
solid orange wire → position 6 next with clip facing away
white with brown stripe wire → position 7 next with clip facing away
solid brown wire → position 8 on far right with clip facing away
cutters → closed across wire tips to trim even
watch_for: if green and orange pairs are swapped the ends will not cross correctly, check striped green is first not striped orange
if tips are uneven some wires will miss the front, trim again until all even
5.check_yourself: It should look like eight flat parallel wires extend in green first order ready to insert.
5.safety: Keep fingers behind the cutter blades, so you do not nick your skin.

6.title: Push wires fully into plug
6.say: Hold the new clear plug with the little clip facing down, so the wire order stays correct. Push the flat row of wires into the back of the new clear plug, so the tips reach the far front.
placements: new clear plug → held with little locking clip facing down and gold teeth facing up, in the video held over dark table
flat row of eight ordered wires → pushed into back opening of new clear plug until tips touch far front
watch_for: if wires fold or cross the order moved, pull out and line them up again
if tips stop short of the front the plug will fail, push harder until all reach the end
6.check_yourself: It should look like the clear plug sits on the wire ends with colored wires visible reaching the front.

7.title: Squeeze plug tight with tool
7.say: Put the clear plug into the squeezing tool opening, so the gold teeth press down. Squeeze the handles hard, so the plug grips the cable.
placements: clear plug with wires inside → set fully into squeezing tool opening with outer cover tucked inside back of plug, in the video orange handled tool on dark table
squeezing tool handles → squeezed shut to press gold teeth and flatten plug
watch_for: if the outer cover hangs outside the plug the end will break, push cover in before squeezing
if the plug looks crooked or loose the tool was not straight, squeeze again firmly
7.check_yourself: It should look like the clear plug is flattened onto the wires with outer cover tucked inside the plug.
7.safety: Keep fingers clear of the tool jaws, so you do not pinch your hand.

8.title: Slide cover over plug end
8.say: Slide the small cover up the cable and over the back of the clear plug, so it hugs the plug.
placements: small protective cover → slid up network cable and over back of crimped clear plug until snug, in the video blue boot covering back of plug
watch_for: if the cover will not move the plug edge catches, wiggle it gently while pushing
if the cover leaves the plug back bare it is not far enough, push until it hugs tight
8.check_yourself: It should look like the small cover wraps the back of the clear plug on the finished crossover end.
